title: "Sample-level COI"

This page compares sample-level complexity of infection on the full MAD^4^HatTeR panel and on the 15-target panel. The simulated data are described in [Simulated datasets](../website_docs/data_simulated.qmd). The populations kept for the comparison are listed on the [benchmarking overview](../website_docs/benchmarking.qmd).

The tools are [naive COI](../tutorials/PGEcore/naive_COI/background.Rmd), [MOIRE](../tutorials/moire/moire_background.Rmd), [TheREALMcCOIL](../tutorials/THEREALMcCOIL/RMCL_background.Rmd), [coiaf](../tutorials/coiaf/coiaf_background.Rmd), and [SNP-slice](../tutorials/SNP-slice/background.Rmd).

For each tool and each panel, the parameter set is the one with the highest Lin's concordance on samples whose true COI is 2 through 9. The reported summaries are Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and mean bias. Bias is the estimate minus the simulated COI. Monoclonal samples are summarised on their own. Error is also summarised for each true COI from 1 through 9.

Population mean COI is on a [separate page](coi_mean.qmd). Effective COI is on its [own page](moire_ecoi.qmd) and uses the MOIRE parameter set chosen here.

```{r}
#| include: false
bench_src <- c("benchmark_data.R", file.path("benchmarking", "benchmark_data.R"))
source(bench_src[file.exists(bench_src)][1])
full_sample <- sample_coi_results("full")
mini_sample <- sample_coi_results("subselection")
```

## Full panel

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Estimates for the parameter set with the highest Lin's concordance on samples whose simulated COI is 2 through 9. Boxes show samples with simulated COI 1 through 9. The line is equality, and the vertical axis stops at 15."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5
plot_sample_coi(full_sample)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Lin's concordance within each population for that parameter set, on samples whose simulated COI is 2 through 9. The dotted line is at 0.95."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 4.5
plot_sample_ccc(full_sample)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  full_sample$metrics,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and bias on samples whose simulated COI is 2 through 9. A monoclonal call is an estimate below 1.5 among samples whose simulated COI is 1."
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Mean absolute error within each population at each simulated COI from 1 through 9. Populations with a mean absolute error of 6 or above are omitted."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_sample_mae(full_sample)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Mean error within each population at each simulated COI from 1 through 9. Mean error is the estimate minus the simulated COI. The red line is zero. Populations with a mean absolute error of 6 or above are omitted."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_sample_error(full_sample)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Share of samples with simulated COI 1 whose estimate is below 1.5."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
plot_monoclonal(full_sample)
```
